providers.notes: Responses API is the recommended default. Chat Completions remains supported. /v1/models lists IDs only (no capability fields).

Native Gemini API uses x-goog-api-key header. OpenAI-compatible endpoint uses Bearer auth. EMP prefers Chat Completions (OpenAI-compatible) as a compatibility choice; Google recommends the native Gemini API for full feature access.

OpenRouter is a live aggregator. It exposes OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages skins over the same base URL. GET /api/v1/models returns rich per-model metadata including supported_parameters (tools, reasoning, structured_outputs, response_format, etc.). Model capabilities are inherited from upstream providers; OpenRouter standardizes the interface. parallel_tool_calls defaults true. reasoning_effort enum: xhigh, high, medium, low, minimal, none.

Messages API at POST /v1/messages. Auth via x-api-key or Bearer token (Workload Identity Federation). anthropic-version header required. Models API returns capabilities object including max_input_tokens, max_tokens. Effort parameter defaults to high on Opus 5 and Sonnet 5.
OpenAI-compatible REST API at https://api.x.ai. Also gRPC API. Responses API and Chat Completions both supported. Reasoning cannot be disabled.
Meta publishes model weights and reference code. Official hosted API docs are login-gated; no public API root is registered.

OpenAI-compatible API at api.moonshot.ai. List Models returns supports_image_in, supports_video_in, supports_reasoning fields. kimi-k2 series discontinued May 25, 2026; use kimi-k2.6+. thinking param {type: enabled|disabled}. kimi-k3 uses reasoning_effort field.

OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API + Anthropic-compatible API. Thinking mode controlled via thinking param (enabled/disabled). reasoning_effort: high, max (low/medium mapped to high, xhigh mapped to max). deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner deprecated 2026-07-24, mapped to v4-flash non-thinking/thinking modes. The current official deepseek-flash route supports vision. Retired deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp IDs now route to it; this endpoint-specific redirect does not apply to aggregators retaining the original weights.

OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API. International endpoint: https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4 (documented at docs.z.ai). China endpoint: https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4 (documented at https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/api/introduction). No documented GET /models endpoint; models are enumerated in the API reference enum field.
OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions with Bearer API keys. Use ordinary streaming; diffusing=true sends intermediate full-text replacements rather than append-only deltas.
